name: Greenmote Build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: main
    tags: ['*']

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    uses: DreamWeave-MP/StroggForge/.github/workflows/rustGlobalBuild.yml@v43
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      binary_names: '["greenmote"]'
      # Optional: set NEXUS_API_KEY and NEXUS_GROUP_IDS repository or organization secrets
      # to upload release archives to Nexus Mods. Use StroggForge's
      # .github/nexus_group_ids.template.json as the NEXUS_GROUP_IDS shape.
      generate_benchmarks: true
      enable_android: true
      enable_portmaster: true
      cargo_publish: false
workflows..github/workflows/daily.yml:
name: Daily Rust Quality Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # GitHub cron is UTC. 15:00 UTC is 9 AM Central Standard Time.
    - cron: '0 15 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run rustfmt
        run: cargo fmt --all --check

  clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -W clippy::pedantic -D warnings

  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-audit
      - name: Run Cargo audit
        run: cargo audit
